reads.title: Shrines are the consensus opener
reads.body: Almost every creator opens with the Shrine wheel (Syncretism, Path of Worship, Supplication) because it buffs any build and costs nothing. The money trees then branch into Essence, Strongboxes, Harvest or map mods.

reads.title: Essence looks strongest
reads.body: The biggest rework in the tree: guaranteed top-tier Essences, corrupting twice, and 3.30 makes Essences scale with map tier.

reads.title: Map bosses are worth more
reads.body: 3.30 drops the old rule that cut boss currency drops, and Destructive Play summons extra Atlas bosses on every Maven kill.

reads.title: Ritual fits the new loot
reads.body: Blind Allegiance makes equipment favours unidentified with Item Tiers, and Occult Devotion means four altars every time.

reads.title: Unstable Breach to watch
reads.body: Massing Forces can add 2, 3 or even 10 Unstable Breaches. Strong for density, but untested until launch.

reads.title: Strongboxes and Abyss
reads.body: New Empyrean Apparatus and Vaal Vessel boxes, plus Abyssal Depths and Abyss Jewels with 5 or 6 mods. Good backup wheels.

reads.title: Gwennen for crafters
reads.body: Kalguuran Companionship gives 150% more Gwennen Expeditions, which matters if her new 3.30 crafting service pays.

trees.name: Essence and Sacred Flora
trees.author: Exile Ledger draft
trees.tagline: League start into early red maps. Feeds the Crafting tab directly.
why: 3.30 makes Essences scale with map tier, and this wheel got the biggest upgrade in the tree.
Amplified Energies puts at least one top-tier Essence on every Imprisoned Monster, and Crystal Lattice sometimes adds 3 more.
Recrystallisation plus Commensurate Corruption lets you corrupt twice and turn every Essence on the monster into one type.
Sacred Flora (Harvest now spawns in maps) pairs with Nature's Favour, which sends Wildwood Wisps to Imprisoned Monsters first.
You keep the Essences and lifeforce you need for the Essence and Harvest crafts on the site, and sell the rest.
run: Pick the Essence types on the choice notables that sell best on day 1 (Greed and Woe are safe, since the crafts use them).
Kill the Wisp-empowered Imprisoned Monster after the Flora spreads, not before.
Corrupt only monsters with a Deafening Essence on them, since Commensurate Corruption turns all of them into one type.
Open every Strongbox: the tree takes Tamper-Proof and Arcanist's caches on the way past.

choices.why: Used by the life crafts. Swap to Woe if ES gear sells better.
Bow quiver and attack crafts. Check prices on day 1.
Pick whichever lifeforce colour sells highest.

trees.threads: No Essence Threads exist, so put your Threads on map sustain or sell them.
trees.risk: Low. Imprisoned Monsters with 6+ top Essences hit hard, so skip corrupting them on a weak character.

trees.name: Maven boss rush
trees.author: Exile Ledger draft
trees.tagline: Fast maps, kill the boss, leave. Built around the 3.30 boss loot change.
why: 3.30 removes the old rule that cut the currency map bosses drop, so bosses are worth far more than before.
Destructive Play makes The Maven summon 1 to 3 extra Atlas bosses on every witnessed map boss.
The Most Toys and the Maven small nodes count kills as extra witnesses, which speeds up Maven invitations.
Thorough Exploration empowers the final boss with Wildwood Wisps once fewer than 50 monsters remain.
Fate Bespoken, Chittering Champions and Gilded Armour pile extra cards, Threads and gold onto the boss kill.
run: Run fast single-boss maps, clear to under 50 monsters, then fight the boss with The Maven watching.
Fate Bespoken sends every card in the map to the boss, so kill it every time or you lose them.
Stack map mods that boost the boss: they also apply to the bosses The Maven summons.
Sell or run the Conqueror, Shaper and Elder maps the tree drops.
trees.threads: Run Threads that add map bosses or boss rewards once you see what drops.
trees.risk: High. The summoned bosses copy the map boss's mods, so you need a strong single-target build.

trees.name: Ritual and Unstable Breach
trees.author: Exile Ledger draft
trees.tagline: Juiced density for tiered items and Ritual favours. Best once your build kills fast.
why: In 3.30, rarity decides what drops and tiered items are worth picking up. Blind Allegiance makes Ritual equipment favours unidentified with Item Tiers.
Occult Devotion means every map with Ritual has four altars, and Blood Pact shows 30% more favours.
Unstable Breach monsters feed Ritual tribute. Massing Forces adds 2, 3 or (1%) 10 more Unstable Breaches.
Multiple Fronts and Clawed Open make each extra breach harder and more rewarding.
Seeing Double, Anomie and Imperfect Reflections add tougher rares that drop more.
run: Open the Unstable Breaches first, pull the monsters into the Ritual circles, then start the altars.
Defer the good favours. Flexible Dogma gives you extra rerolls.
Turn your loot filter up for tiered unidentified items from favours.
Run Ritual and Breach Threads once you can afford them.

choices.why: The rest of the Breach nodes here only work with Unstable Breaches.
Pick the Wombgift type that sells highest on day 1.

trees.threads: Dextral Threads can push Thread drops toward Ritual and Breach, so you can run more of them.
trees.risk: Medium. Lots of monsters at once, so it needs a clear-speed build.

Adds Mirages with Timeworn Sands and Fata Morgana.
Uses the same Maven pair as the boss rush tree: Destructive Play and The Most Toys.
Seeing Double and Imperfect Reflections add duplicated and mirrored rares, and the map nodes help sustain red maps.

why: Every Strongbox notable: Tamper-Proof, Secret Compartments, Security Measures, Fortune Seeker and Augured Cache.
